units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:4">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00821"><he>חִינּוּן</he></cite>.
Ab. Zar. 5ᵃ (ref. to Lev. XXVI, 3) אין אם אלא לשון ת׳ im means prayer (Oh that).

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:9">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 118b:9">Pes. 118ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 116:1">Ps. CXVI, 1</cite>) <he>אימתי אני אהובה … קול תַּחֲנוּנָי</he> when am I beloved before thee? When thou hearest the voice of my supplications.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:2:3">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ויהיו דברינו ת׳ לפניך</he> and let our words be (words of) supplications before thee, i.e. truly devotional; a. fr.
